severity_name: HEAVY SLOP WARNING — LABELING INTEGRITY ADVISORY
headline: HEAVY SLOP WARNING: SYNTHETIC-COMMENTARY FRONT BLANKETS FIVE REGIONS AS SWARMS OF AGREEABLE REPLY ACCOUNTS DEPOSIT ENDLESS 'GREAT POINT, WELL SAID' RUNOFF BENEATH EVERY POST, INCLUDING POSTS THAT MADE NO POINT AT ALL
advisory: A dense system of synthetic commentary has settled over the comment sections of all major regions and is expected to persist through the weekend. Residents are advised that a reply expressing warm, content-free agreement within four seconds of posting is not a fan, a friend, or a colleague, but weather. The Service notes that new platform labeling programs are being deployed as a countermeasure, and that some of the labels are, regrettably, also weather.

regional_outlook.conditions: Thick agreement fog with scattered 'Couldn't agree more, and here's why.' Visibility reduced as every post accrues forty identical affirmations before a human reads it.
Gusting reply swarms reaching sustained volumes. Any post over 200 impressions triggers a coordinated deposit of vague praise and one account asking to 'DM the details.'
Warm, syrupy engagement pooling in low-lying groups. 'Amen, so true' accumulating faster than moderators can drain it.
Pinned top comment is synthetic; the reply to the synthetic comment is also synthetic. Genuine human confusion detected mid-thread.
Fresh labeling stations installed overnight. Roughly half the 'AI-generated' tags are themselves generated. Proceed with caution.

specimen.habitat: Comment sections, quote-reply threads, and the first three notifications you receive on any public post.
specimen.field_marks: Impossibly fast. Praises the post without referencing its contents. Uses the poster's first name once, warmly, as if reunited after years. Deploys exactly one emoji, always slightly wrong.
specimen.call: This is such an underrated take — thanks for putting words to what so many of us are feeling! Following for more.
specimen.confusion_species: Easily mistaken for a genuinely supportive stranger. Distinguish by the response time (under five seconds), the total absence of any detail unique to your post, and the way it says 'great thread' beneath a single-sentence photo of a sandwich.

spotter_tip: Reply to the reply with a plain factual question — 'which part did you like?' A human answers. The specimen either vanishes or compliments your question.
tomorrow: Commentary fog lifting slightly by afternoon as moderation queues catch up, followed by a fresh swarm timed to the evening posting peak.

confirmed_sighting.report: An analysis this week examined how major social platforms are responding to mounting user backlash against low-quality AI-generated content, including new labeling and moderation approaches. The Service observes, with professional interest, that the tools built to identify the weather have now become a recognized part of the weather.
